entities.summary: Ottoman Empire, a political institution in Albania during Albanian Principalities and Skanderbeg (1443–1468). Grew from Principality of Arbër and Feudal Lords. Led to the emergence of Skanderbeg's Resistance to the Ottomans and Skanderbeg raises Albanian revolt and the League of Lezhë is formed.
